title: Preserve your exp
description: Preserve the experience in a jar so you never lose it !
body:
![Preserve your xp by kheyde](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2dae440130cd0288bcdeae0487f20854a7da733.png)

This mod lets you convert your experience into a jar for safekeeping. Finish your XP soaring into the world of Minecraft!

It's easy! Create an experience jar using glass and any terracotta, then right-click (your player level must be at least 1).

![La personne utilise la jar d'xp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28193ea2bd3a4edb343d34f32a557d48354a88b0.gif)
